placements.lead: During his time in the villa, Sean proved to be a steady and ultimately victorious islander, placing 1st and winning Perfect Match 1 with Freya. He began coupled with Skye from episode 1 until Skye was dumped, before Freya picked him in episode 4 and their showmance carried them to the final. Although Dante and Pablo both picked Freya at recouplings, Sean took her back each time, later weathering a split over Zara and clashes with Pablo and Riza. After surviving 3 public votes, he and Freya won with 37% of the public vote.
placements.personality: Sean often covered nerves with dry humour, whether joking about saying hello to a plant or obsessing over his hair before a tense return. Around Freya he became openly loyal, repeatedly framing his choices as simple and refusing to entertain other options. When cornered, he could turn sharp, as seen in his rows with Pablo and Riza, but he also tried not to make Freya watch him fall apart.

quotes.text: I said I'm fine. I'm not fine. But I'm not going to make Freya watch me fall apart.
quotes.context: in the diary room after Freya ended things

quotes.text: If Freya did this to me, I'd be heartbroken. So I'm not going to do it to Freya. It's as simple as that.
I've done my hair three times. My hair is fine. My hair is not the problem. My nerves are the problem.
quotes.context: in the diary room before Freya returned

trivia: Sean joked on night one that he thought he said hello to a plant.
He and Lucia were once shown lying on the lawn guessing what everyone across the garden was talking about.
In the blindfolded challenge, Freya guided him without raising her voice and they finished quickly.

placements.lead: During her time in the villa, Freya proved to be a central romantic figure, placing 1st and winning Perfect Match 1 with Sean. She arrived as a new islander in episode 3, picked Sean at the episode 4 recoupling, and remained in that single coupling through the final. Her showmance was tested when Dante and Pablo picked her and Sean took her back, and later when she ended it with Sean over a love triangle with Zara. After surviving 3 public votes, she and Sean won with 37% of the public vote.
placements.personality: Freya was funny and self-aware, often using jokes to dodge questions when she was rattled. She could be blunt about not leading people on, but she also worried about hurting them, especially Dante. As her relationship with Sean deepened, she became more openly emotional, crying over love and later grinning through exclusivity while still admitting fear about everything happening on television.

quotes.text: Hiya, I'm Freya. I've been told to just be myself, so you're about to get a lot of me. Sorry in advance.
I need to tell you something, and I'm terrified. I love you.
Sean asked me to be exclusive. I've been smiling for about an hour. My face hurts. I don't care.
quotes.context: in the diary room after Sean's question

trivia: Freya described villa time as faster, saying a day in the villa was like a week outside.
She called her and Sean's baby-challenge performance brilliant parenting, even though it was only for a doll.
She and Zara had an awkward kitchen moment after both knew why being alone together felt loaded.

placements.lead: During his time in the villa, Riza became a finalist, placing 2nd as runner-up with Zara. He arrived in episode 11, first coupled with Mei from episode 13 until Mei left him for Callum, then was picked by Zara in episode 15 and stayed with her to the final. His run included a showmance with Zara, clashes with Mei and Sean, and repeated appearances in the bottom of the public vote. After surviving 3 public votes, he and Zara finished 2nd.
placements.personality: Riza presented himself as controlled and private, repeatedly admitting that his real opinions stayed with him. He was capable of quiet scheming, especially when he tried to keep conversations from reaching his partner, but he also showed hurt plainly when Mei moved on. With Zara, his guardedness softened into declarations and family-day seriousness, though guilt and fear still followed him into moments like the Hideaway.

quotes.text: I gave my opinion. Not my real one. My real one stays with me.

quotes.text: You got Pablo dumped because you felt threatened. Say it. Just say it.
Seeing my family with Zara made it all feel real. This isn't a holiday any more. This is my actual life.

Her showmance with Riza carried her through a turbulent late run that included bottom public votes and a row with Ayesha. After surviving 3 public votes, she and Riza finished 2nd.
placements.personality: Zara announced herself as loud, but much of her story showed someone trying to keep a calm face while feeling exposed. She often used humour or agreement as protection, admitting that agreeing was safer than talking. Her friendships mattered to her, especially with Mei, but she could also be suspicious of villa gossip and direct when a confrontation got too heated.

placements.personality: Malik mixed awkward charm with a tendency to retreat when overwhelmed, often smiling and saying the right thing while privately admitting uncertainty. placements.personality: Ayesha was observant and strategic about what she shared, often distinguishing between what she saw, what she told people, and what she kept for herself. She could be playful and ridiculous with friends, but she also knew when to stand back and watch a row unfold. With Malik, she moved from uncertainty to public commitment, becoming increasingly open about calling him her boyfriend.

Their showmance survived Casa Amor, repeated recouplings, and a bottom public vote late in the season. After surviving 3 public votes, Rafael was dumped in episode 25.
placements.personality: Rafael was warm, expressive and often funny, with Portuguese phrases and dramatic honesty colouring the way he spoke. He presented loyalty as important, but his confessionals showed private doubts and attractions he tried to manage quietly. He was also a comforter in the villa, shown listening, keeping an arm around Malik, and saying nobody should have to cry alone.

quotes.text: Gente, hello! I am Rafael. I have practised this bit in the mirror about forty times, and I have still forgotten what I was going to say.

placements.personality: Lucia was affectionate and sociable, quickly naming Ayesha as her person, but she also had a habit of carrying information around the villa. With Rafael she was tender and increasingly vulnerable, even when telling him she loved him before he was ready to say it back.

He arrived in episode 7, first tried to pick Freya but lost her straight back to Sean, then coupled with Zara from episode 10 until Casa Amor. At Casa Amor he came back with Valentina, leaving Zara and beginning the showmance that lasted until his dumping. After surviving 2 public votes and receiving 5 votes against, Dante was dumped in episode 23.
placements.personality: Dante entered enjoying the tension he created, but his strongest material came from learning to speak about feelings. He was embarrassed and wounded when rejected publicly, then became increasingly open with Valentina, repeatedly saying she made difficult conversations easier. When challenged, he could be defensive and fiery, but his exit confessionals were proud rather than bitter.

quotes.text: Mamma mia, I walked in, and I could feel every single couple tense up. I am not going to lie, I loved it a little bit.
quotes.context: in the diary room on arrival

quotes.text: Allora, I have just been taken from in front of the whole villa. I am smiling. I am smiling so I do not scream.

placements.personality: Valentina was sharp, playful and self-aware, often turning awkwardness into a joke before admitting what sat underneath. She could be candid about not always behaving well, and later spoke about wanting to be judged by what she did next. With Dante she became noticeably softer, describing him as someone she could be completely honest with.

He then came back from Casa Amor with Anna in episode 13, beginning a showmance that lasted until his dumping. After surviving 1 public vote, receiving 7 votes against, and clashing most with Sean, Pablo was dumped in episode 21.
placements.personality: Pablo tried to be the fun, joking presence, but his confessionals often showed someone anxious about how he was being perceived. With Anna he valued easy conversation and became more emotionally honest than he expected. When pressure built, he was prone to spiralling over every joke and face he had pulled, yet he also pushed back directly in his row with Sean.

quotes.text: I'm Pablo. I've had a haircut, I've been to the gym every day for a month, and I'm still not ready. Let's go.

I'm going to miss them so much. Even the ones who drove me mad. Especially the ones who drove me mad.

trivia: Pablo and Anna once sat on the edge of the bed fully dressed hours too early.

Their showmance continued through later recouplings, but Anna repeatedly voiced uncertainty about whether she felt as sure as Pablo did. After surviving 1 public vote and receiving 7 votes against, Anna was dumped in episode 21.
placements.personality: Anna was thoughtful and conflicted, often saying little in the moment while privately admitting her head was elsewhere. She appreciated that Pablo asked the right questions, but she struggled with matching his certainty and held back the parts of herself that felt unsafe to reveal. Around others she could be gently direct, and her friendship moments often happened in quieter spaces like swing seats and late-night beds.

quotes.text: Pablo asked the right questions. Nobody asks the right questions.

placements.lead: During her time in the villa, Mei placed 10th and was dumped after a complicated path through several couplings. She arrived on night one, had Arjun stolen by Blair, and later coupled with Callum from episode 4 until Casa Amor. She came back from Casa Amor with Riza, then left Riza for Callum in episode 15 and coupled with Callum again until Callum was dumped. Mei was stolen 1 time, clashed most with Riza, received 6 votes against, and was dumped in episode 19.
placements.personality: Mei was observant, controlled and often deliberately calm, especially when she knew shouting would give someone else what they wanted. She listened more than she talked and used smiling, nodding and changing the subject as a defence. Beneath that composure, she was deeply attached to her friends, especially Zara, and her choices around Callum, Riza and Rafael showed how much she tried to manage messy feelings without admitting them too soon.

quotes.text: I'm Mei. I'm told I come across as quite serious. I'm not. I've just got one of those faces.

I'm good at this. Too good. Smile, nod, change the subject.

placements.lead: During his brief time in the villa, Kevin placed 12th and was dumped. He arrived as a new islander in episode 14 and immediately set his sights on Lucia, despite her being coupled with Rafael. Lucia turned him down politely, and Kevin tried to take the rejection with humour. He was dumped in episode 15.
placements.personality: Kevin came in direct and flirtatious, saying he already knew who he wanted to talk to and trusting his first look. He was not shown long enough for a major arc, but his short stay presented him as bold without wanting to wreck anyone's life. After Lucia rejected him, he handled the sting with self-deprecating humour and a face-mask plan.

quotes.text: I'm Kevin. I've had a haircut, I've been to the gym every day for a month, and I'm still not ready. Let's go.
You're coupled up, and I'm not here to wreck anyone's life. But I think it'd be stupid of me not to at least find out if there's something here.
Right. I'm going to put a face mask on, and then I'm going to be fine.

trivia: Kevin's phone went in episode 14, making the villa go quiet.
Rafael patted the bed next to Kevin after Lucia had rejected him.
At the recoupling, Kevin was the only islander still standing while everyone else was coupled up.

placements.lead: During her brief time in the villa, Amara placed 13th and was dumped. She arrived as a new islander in episode 11, presenting herself as a girl's girl and a calm presence. Across Casa Amor, she mostly appeared advising other islanders about whether to pursue their interests. She was dumped in episode 13.
placements.personality: Amara was forthright about loyalty to her friends, warning that a problem with them was a problem with her. Her short thread showed her more as an adviser than as the centre of a romance, especially with Valentina and Georgia. She encouraged people to take their chance, but she was also quick to point out when someone's face had already given them away.

quotes.text: I'm a girl's girl, first and foremost. If you've got a problem with my friends, you've got a problem with me.
If you wait for them to fall out, you could be waiting all summer.
You don't have to. Your face is saying it. Dante is coupled up with Zara, in case you missed that bit.

trivia: Amara's arrival on the terrace made the whole room go quiet.
Valentina dragged Amara to the end of the garden, out of earshot, for advice.
Rafael found Amara cooling off in the shade by the gym.

ep13: DUMPED
placements.lead: During his brief time in the villa, Antwon placed 13th and was dumped. He arrived as a new islander in episode 11 and soon turned his attention toward Freya, despite her being coupled with Sean. He asked for a conversation and accepted that Freya respected her existing relationship. He was dumped in episode 13.
placements.personality: Antwon introduced himself as serious-looking but principled, putting manners at the centre of what he wanted. He was direct when pursuing Freya, insisting he only wanted a conversation rather than asking Sean to step aside. His limited screen time showed embarrassment after rejection, but also enough humour to retreat to a face mask.

quotes.text: Manners. That's my thing. Please, thank you, hold the door. If you're rude to someone serving you, that's it, we're done, I don't care what you look like.
I'm not asking Sean to step aside. I just want to have one conversation with Freya and see.
Yeah. Ouch is right.

trivia: Antwon sat up suddenly while lying on the sunbeds with Elias.
Freya sat next to him on the daybed, but not too close.
When Antwon entered the dressing room, the others stopped what they were doing.

placements.name: Elias
timeline: ep11: arrived as a new islander
ep13: DUMPED
placements.lead: During his brief time in the villa, Elias placed 13th and was dumped. He arrived as a new islander in episode 11, openly nervous but excited about walking into the villa. During Casa Amor he explored connections with several islanders, including Freya, Mei, Zara and Ayesha. He was dumped in episode 13.
placements.personality: Elias was gentle, earnest and a little nervous, with several lines built around encouragement rather than pressure. He pushed others to take chances and did the same himself with Ayesha, saying he did not want to wonder what if. His flirtation style was soft and practical, involving compliments, questions and watermelon.

quotes.text: Walking down those steps with everyone looking at me was terrifying. My legs were shaking. I'd do it again in a heartbeat.
quotes.context: in the diary room on arrival

quotes.text: The occasion is, I want to talk to you, and watermelon helps.
I went for it with Ayesha. I wasn't going to sit here in a few weeks wondering what if. I've done that before, and it's horrible. So I asked.
quotes.context: in the diary room after speaking to Ayesha

trivia: Elias brought Mei a slice of watermelon and kept one for himself.
He and Freya sat back on the daybeds after a long swim.
He waited until Malik had gone inside before walking over to Ayesha.

placements.name: Georgia
timeline: ep11: arrived as a new islander
ep13: DUMPED
placements.lead: During her brief time in the villa, Georgia placed 13th and was dumped. She arrived as a new islander in episode 11, describing herself as loud and immediately asking who was coupled up and who was actually coupled up. In Casa Amor she explored conversations with Pablo, Malik and Dante. She was dumped in episode 13.
placements.personality: Georgia was lively, nosy and socially forward, often initiating chats rather than waiting to be chosen. She framed herself as the friend who remembers everyone's birthday but forgets her own, which matched her mix of warmth and scattered boldness. Her short stay showed her testing possibilities quickly, especially when she kept looking over at the pool or asked directly what someone did when they liked someone.

quotes.text: Right, I'm Georgia. Who's coupled up and who's actually coupled up? There's a difference.
I'm the friend who remembers everyone's birthday. I'm also the friend who forgets their own. That's kind of me in a nutshell.
Talk to me. I can't sleep.

trivia: Dante brought Georgia a slice of watermelon and kept one for himself.
Georgia offered Pablo a hand up off the sunbed.
Georgia and Amara made drinks in the kitchen while Georgia kept looking over at the pool.

placements.name: Makaio
timeline: ep11: arrived as a new islander
ep13: DUMPED
placements.lead: During his brief time in the villa, Makaio placed 13th and was dumped. He arrived as a new islander in episode 11 alongside Riza and the other Casa Amor arrivals. His story mostly centred on trying to start conversations with Lucia and Ayesha while others' established couples loomed over him. He was dumped in episode 13.
placements.personality: Makaio was hopeful and direct, often asking for proper conversations rather than performing for the group. Because his time was short, he was seen more as a gentle pursuer than a fully developed villa personality. He tried to reassure others, including telling Antwon that Freya would regret not seeing he was a catch.

quotes.text: Don't mind us. We're just going to get to know absolutely everyone.
quotes.context: on arriving with the new islanders

quotes.text: I'm sorry. I know you're with Malik. I just think you deserve someone who can't stop looking at you.
For what it's worth, I think Freya is going to regret it. You're a catch. Freya just hasn't realised yet.

trivia: Makaio arrived with Riza and the others, laughing about something from the car.
He approached Lucia with a hopeful smile in episode 12.
He sat on the arm of Ayesha's beanbag during Casa Amor.

placements.name: Shamar
timeline: ep11: arrived as a new islander
ep13: DUMPED
placements.lead: During his brief time in the villa, Shamar placed 13th and was dumped. He arrived during the Casa Amor period and was shown exploring chats with Freya, Lucia and Zara. His most pointed late moment came when he confronted the tension around both him and another islander liking Zara. He was dumped in episode 13.
placements.personality: Shamar was understated and dry, often turning a line into a small joke rather than a grand speech. He could be hesitant, telling someone he was not ready for anything, but later became more open with Zara about not wanting their chat to end. His limited screen time made him a quieter Casa presence, but not a passive one.

quotes.text: I'm not ready for anything. Not with anyone. I'm sorry.
I really like talking to you. Like, more than I thought I would. I came over here thinking it'd be a quick chat, and I don't want it to end.
Can we stop pretending? We both like Zara. Everyone knows we both like Zara. And every time I sit with Zara, you find a reason to walk past.

trivia: Shamar pulled up a beanbag beside Freya.
He and Lucia ended up in the same bed after the lights went out.
Zara and Shamar were still awake facing each other while everyone else slept.

placements.name: Kaylee
timeline: ep9: arrived as a new islander
ep10: DUMPED
placements.lead: During her brief time in the villa, Kaylee placed 19th and was dumped. She arrived as a new islander in episode 9 and quickly made clear she was single, interested and aware that others were already coupled up. She explored interest in Callum and faced the pressure of a recoupling without a secure partner. She was dumped in episode 10.
placements.personality: Kaylee was direct but good-humoured, setting ground rules on dates and asking people whether they were honestly happy. She wanted calm and safety, yet she was also willing to stir a little by questioning whether existing couples were as solid as they looked. Her short stay ended with embarrassment handled with dignity, cream, and a final look back at the villa.

quotes.text: I'm not looking for a husband or a wife. I'm looking for a good time and a great tan. Anything else is extra.
I'm single going into a recoupling. Do you know how that feels? Every couple in here is going to stand up and pick each other, and I'm going to be sitting on that bench hoping somebody says my name.
I'm going to marry Sean. I'm going to snog Callum. And Lucia, this pie is with love. A lot of love. And a lot of cream.

trivia: Kaylee's phone went in episode 9 and the villa went quiet.
After being pied, she licked the cream off with great dignity.
She took one last look at the villa from the top of the steps.

placements.name: Imani
timeline: ep7: arrived as a new islander
ep8: DUMPED
placements.lead: During her brief time in the villa, Imani placed 20th and was dumped. She arrived as a new islander in episode 7, saying she knew what she wanted and had come in for Malik. She also dated Sean and explored villa conversations, but did not secure a lasting couple. She was dumped in episode 8.
placements.personality: Imani was confident, blunt and not interested in pretending her motives were vague. She asked direct questions about happiness and attraction, but also found quick friendship with Ayesha, with whom she joked about being among the only sensible people there. Her short stay made her feel like a precise disruption rather than a wandering bombshell.

quotes.text: I'm Imani. I don't really do small talk, so I'll keep this short: I know what I want, and I'm going in there to get it.
I came in here for Malik. I'm not going to pretend I didn't. Everyone else can pretend if they like.
Brown's not a flavour.

trivia: Imani and Ayesha made lunch for everyone together.
She and Ayesha sat by the pool and agreed again that they were the only sensible ones there.
Ayesha squeezed Imani so tight that Imani laughed.

placements.name: Theo
timeline: ep1: arrived on night one; coupled up with Zara
ep2: picked Zara again at the recoupling
ep4: picked Zara again at the recoupling
ep6: in the bottom of the public vote; DUMPED
placements.lead: During his time in the villa, Theo placed 21st and was dumped after coupling with Zara. He arrived on night one, coupled up with Zara, and picked her again at the episode 2 and episode 4 recouplings. Their coupling lasted from episode 1 to episode 6, when Theo was in the bottom of the public vote and was dumped. Theo left still emotionally attached to the villa and the people in it.
placements.personality: Theo came across as guarded but deeply feeling, repeatedly describing himself as easy to talk to but not easy to know. He was close to Arjun and Blair, and several of his scenes involved quiet emotional support rather than big confrontations. With Zara, he was frightened of giving too much and getting nothing back, but he still described himself as all in.

quotes.text: Zara said I was easy to talk to. I'm easy to talk to. I'm just not easy to know.
quotes.context: in the diary room about Zara

quotes.text: Honestly? I'm scared of getting it wrong. I've been in situations before where I gave everything and got nothing back, and I told myself I'd never do that again. And then I came in here, and I met you, and I'm doing it again. I'm all in. And that's terrifying.
I'm going to miss them so much. Even the ones who drove me mad. Especially the ones who drove me mad.
quotes.context: in the diary room after being dumped

trivia: Theo called himself "The Sunbed Champion."
He and Sean stayed out on the terrace after dinner as the last two at the table.
Theo sat on the bathroom floor with Blair until her tears stopped.

placements.name: Arjun
timeline: ep1: arrived on night one; coupled up with Blair
ep2: picked Blair again at the recoupling
ep4: picked Ayesha at the recoupling; picked Ayesha, who was Malik's partner, and lost Ayesha straight back to Malik; was left single at the recoupling
ep6: in the bottom of the public vote; DUMPED
placements.lead: During his time in the villa, Arjun placed 21st and was dumped after one coupling. He arrived on night one and coupled up with Blair after Blair stole him from Mei, then picked Blair again at the episode 2 recoupling. At the episode 4 recoupling, Arjun picked Ayesha, but Malik took Ayesha straight back and Arjun was left single. He was later in the bottom of the public vote and was dumped in episode 6.
placements.personality: Arjun used noise and humour to hide shyness, even admitting that he was actually really shy underneath. He was willing to take risks, saying out loud who he preferred early on and later picking Ayesha despite Malik. His confessionals showed a private, calculating side too, often keeping his real opinion or the full length of a chat to himself.

quotes.text: That I'm actually really shy. I just hide it with noise.
I was coupled up for about two minutes. Two minutes. I stood up, said a name, felt good about it, sat down. And then Malik stood up, and it was over before I'd even got comfortable.
I wasn't ready. I don't think you ever are. You think you're prepared, and then they say your name.
quotes.context: in the diary room after being dumped

trivia: Arjun put an arm around Mei and sat with her until it got dark.
He brought someone a drink and said, "For being you. Drink it."
Lucia beamed in the kitchen while someone watching Arjun raised an eyebrow.

placements.name: Skye
timeline: ep1: arrived on night one; coupled up with Sean
ep2: was picked again by Sean
ep4: DUMPED
placements.lead: During her time in the villa, Skye placed 23rd and was dumped after coupling with Sean. She arrived on night one, coupled up with Sean, and was picked by him again at the episode 2 recoupling. Their coupling lasted from episode 1 to episode 4, when Skye was dumped. She left saying she had come in for love but was leaving with friends.
placements.personality: Skye was quirky, hungry and secretive, wandering off for snacks while also carrying things she felt she could not reveal. She often sought quiet, private conversations when overwhelmed, repeatedly asking to talk properly away from everyone. Her short stay showed insecurity about Sean and the villa, but also warmth toward people she trusted.

quotes.text: My deal? I'm just being me. Is that a problem already? It's been ten minutes.
I need to get something off my chest, and you're the only one I trust with it.
I came in for love, and I'm leaving with a lot of friends. That's not nothing. That's not nothing at all.
quotes.context: in the diary room after being dumped

trivia: Skye wandered off to find a snack and came back with two.
She crossed the line first in a challenge, with Sean the first there to hug her.
During one lawn moment, Skye was the only person still sitting down.

placements.name: Blair
timeline: ep1: arrived on night one; stole Arjun from Mei; coupled up with Arjun
ep2: was picked again by Arjun
ep4: DUMPED
placements.lead: During her time in the villa, Blair placed 23rd and was dumped after coupling with Arjun. She arrived on night one, stole Arjun from Mei, and coupled up with him. Arjun picked Blair again at the episode 2 recoupling, but their coupling lasted only until episode 4. Blair was dumped in episode 4.
placements.personality: Blair was decisive on arrival, saying she knew what she wanted, but her later scenes showed someone anxious about being made to guess. She often defaulted to saying she was fine even when she was not, and she let others argue about the wrong thing rather than expose what she had actually done. Her closest emotional material came in quieter support scenes with Skye and Theo.

quotes.text: I'm Blair. I don't really do small talk, so I'll keep this short: I know what I want, and I'm going in there to get it.
Do you think Arjun is going off me? Be honest. Actually, don't be honest. Lie to me. I'll know if you're lying, but lie.
It's okay. It's a game. Somebody had to go, and it was me. I'm just glad I met you.

trivia: Blair chose Arjun and Malik for dates when she arrived.
She and Skye were shown taking their make-up off in front of the dressing room mirror.
Theo sat on the bathroom floor with Blair until her tears stopped.
